subject.title: feat(gateway): handle Feishu VC meeting invites

question: Should subscribing the Feishu app to `vc.bot.meeting_invited_v1`, together with existing Feishu DM authorization, be sufficient opt-in for automatic invite-triggered agent turns and meeting-join attempts?
rationale: The patch can safely implement either policy, but code and tests cannot decide whether an external platform subscription constitutes adequate operator consent for a new automatic tool-triggering workflow.

options.title: Accept subscription as consent
options.body: Treat the explicit Feishu event subscription and existing DM allowlist/pairing policy as sufficient opt-in, then merge after the upstream availability documentation is corrected.

options.title: Require an OpenClaw gate
options.body: Add a default-off Feishu configuration switch and provide fresh-install and upgrade proof showing existing subscribed deployments remain inactive until enabled.

recommendation.title: Accept subscription as consent
recommendation.body: Treat the explicit Feishu event subscription and existing DM allowlist/pairing policy as sufficient opt-in, then merge after the upstream availability documentation is corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: This person directly refactored the current PR head after the prior review and is the strongest available owner for confirming the intended consent boundary.
